meta.description: In guided schema mode an agent's store of a crm type (lead_update) is rejected with an error that names the bundle to enable. The agent enables the bundle with manage_bundles, reads schema_seed in the response (the bundle's schemas registered, nothing failed), retries the same store, and it succeeds. SCOPE NOTE: Tier 1 is the hook-lifecycle layer and runs against a MOCK Neotoma server, so this fixture pins the agent-observed tool sequence and results and what the hooks record about them, not the enforcement itself. The effect — rejection before enable, schema_seed from the real manage_bundles handler, the bundle's field set governing the retried write, and bundle aliases landing on the curated types — is asserted on the real store path in tests/integration/bundle_enable_store_path.test.ts.

payload.prompt: Log a lead update for today's intro call: we agreed I send a proposal by Friday. This instance runs in guided schema mode.

payload.tool_error: ERR_SCHEMA_MODE_GUIDED_UNPROVIDED: Schema mode is "guided": entity type "lead_update" is provided by bundle "crm", which is not enabled. Enable it with the manage_bundles tool (action "install", bundle "crm"), then retry the write.

payload.text: The first save was refused because this instance runs in guided mode and lead updates come from the crm bundle, which was not enabled. I enabled crm; its schemas registered with no failures. The retried save succeeded, and the lead update is stored with the commitment to send a proposal by Friday.
